title: potentilla tormentilla var. sciaphila
intro: Potentilla tormentilla var. sciaphila, commonly known as Tormentil, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tormentil include soothing digestive issues, reducing swelling, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Tormentil include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
